summary: Blends two vector pairs into an output vector using SIMDVectorNormalization with a smoothness weighting. First normalizes/combines (a2, a5) into temporary v8 and (a3, a4) into temporary v9 using factor a6; then computes a per-lane coefficient from a6 as 2.0 * (a6 - a6*a6) using the packed constant 0x4000000040000000LL (two 2.0f floats, backed by qword_5AF908), and performs a final SIMDVectorNormalization of v8 and v9 into a1 with that coefficient. Flushes the MMX state (_m_femms) before returning.

local_names.v6: scalar blend coefficient derived from a6

operations.description: Call SIMDVectorNormalization(v8, a2, a5, a6) to produce the first intermediate vector v8 from inputs a2 and a5 under factor a6.
Call SIMDVectorNormalization(v9, a3, a4, a6) to produce the second intermediate vector v9 from inputs a3 and a4 under factor a6.

Compute the blend coefficient per lane as 2.0 * (a6 - a6*a6): _m_pfsub(a6, _m_pfmul(a6, a6)) multiplied by the packed constant 0x4000000040000000LL (two 2.0f floats) loaded from qword_5AF908; a6 is moved into 64-bit SIMD lanes via _mm_cvtsi32_si64.
Call SIMDVectorNormalization(a1, v8, v9, coefficient) to combine the two intermediates into the final output vector stored at a1.
Flush the MMX/SIMD state with _m_femms() and return the pointer to the output at a1.
